cc:Work.dc:title: Native Second Stage Programs
cc:Work.dc:description: All 23 original source programs in the Phase105 native B2 compilation comparison, sorted by prepared-Base ratio to upstream. Teal circles show prepared-Base workflow ratios, amber diamonds show live-Base ratios, each with an independently measured upstream control. Source ratios are geometric means of per-point median process-time ratios; parentheses show point counts. Every role and point has two fresh-process observations in each mode. Prepared native reuses authenticated Base; upstream checks source Base in both modes. Complete compiler process time includes startup, preparation, output and exit; Clang and public CLI are excluded. The 1x line is upstream parity and lower is better.
